scope: Synthetic quantity constraint and browser confirmation; no general version compatibility claim

oracles.zero: quantity zero persists with amount zero
oracles.negative_write: SQL rejects quantity -1 on write, quantity and amount preserved
oracles.confirmation: ORM action transitions draft to confirmed
oracles.browser_19: Chrome loads real Odoo form, clicks object button, observes Confirmed, server reads confirmed and amount 30
oracles.mutant: Same browser scenario completes, then deliberately false server expectation draft must fail

pass_requirements: returncode zero, zero Odoo failures/errors, all expected unique success markers; browser requires Chrome start plus browser success and server confirmation
limits: Admin UI only; no ACL coverage
